name: Tviy krashchyy druh
source:
You play as Kira, a girl who spends almost all holidays at home. One day she got a chance to make a new friend and that's how this story began.

[Translated from [url=https://endemiateam.itch.io/your-best-friend]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是个名叫基拉的女孩，假期几乎全在家里度过。有一天，她遇到了一个结交新朋友的机会。故事就从这里开始。
